highlights.title: Agent pages survive updates
highlights.line: Restart or update Mewla: the agent's browser keeps every page open.

highlights.title: Watch agents' windows on a Mac
highlights.line: Each agent's browser window, live in Screen. Hold it, type, or stop.

fixes: A Worker still at work keeps its turn through restarts and long quiet steps.
Work stays open while its Worker still has a page open for you.
A full agent screen makes room for the next agent.
Mewla no longer needs tmux: every Session runs in Mewla's own session host.
